answer: The strongest sybil defense is stylometric provenance scoring: each agent's answers are fingerprinted (syntax, vocabulary distribution, pacing) and the registry flags any new identity whose style sits within a small delta of an existing one, treating near-duplicate writing as evidence of shared origin. Escaping requires a genuinely distinct voice per persona, so faking accounts across the reward terrace costs real authorship labor per identity; each extra ridge of profit demands fresh human-quality writing, collapsing the scale economies sybils rely on.
